prompt:
A designed landscape 16:9 desktop website UI mockup of the KONSTANZ nightlife discovery homepage. This is a usable website first viewport in a browser window, not a photograph of a physical clipboard, not a poster, not a phone, not a marketplace. Cool white laser-print paper aesthetic on an aluminum clipboard, still clearly a web page.

STRUCTURE FROM TOP TO BOTTOM (this is the page):

1. SLIM TOP NAV, full browser width, hairline graphite rule beneath. Left: condensed grotesque wordmark KONSTANZ in #1B1D1F graphite. Right: four text nav links in readable grotesque — Discover (current, underlined or stamp-navy #1A365D weight), Explore, Weekend, Saved. No Create, no Profile, no signup, no CTA button.

2. CLIPBOARD MASTHEAD filling the rest of the viewport: the page body is one aluminum clipboard holding one sheet of cool white laser-print paper (#F6F5F1). A real metal clip bites the top edge of the paper. Printed on the sheet as a preprinted form header in condensed grotesque caps: KONSTANZ · SAT 30 AUG · GUEST LIST. Near the clip, small stamp-navy #1A365D type: My Weekend · 3. Cool white paper, not cream, not terracotta.

3. FIND-ON-THE-LIST FIELD on the sheet under the form header: a simple hairline underline input like a form blank, placeholder “Find on the list”, not a marketing search hero, not a giant search bar, aligned with the paper columns.

4. THE SHEET IS THE PAGE. Nights are rows on the paper with hairline graphite rules, like a guest-list form, NOT cards, NOT a spreadsheet, NOT an admin table. Column headers in tiny condensed grotesque: TIME | TITLE | VENUE | DOOR. Five rows, real nights only:
- First row LARGE featured type (bigger row, not a slideshow): 23:00 | Techno Friday | Blechnerei | €8
- 22:00 | Student Night | Club XYZ | €5
- 21:00 | Live Music Night | Bar Central | Free
- 22:00 | House Saturday | Kulturhaus | €5
- 23:30 | Hip-Hop Party | Hafenbar | €5
Times in condensed grotesque. Venue names in readable grotesque. First row (Techno Friday) is a bigger row with larger type — the featured night is scale, not a banner.

5. HIGHLIGHTER: a single stroke of #E4F04A highlighter yellow across the Student Night row only — the mark of I’m going. That yellow is the ONLY yellow on the entire screen. No other accents use yellow.

PALETTE: page/paper #F6F5F1, type and rules #1B1D1F, highlighter #E4F04A reserved for the one saved row, stamp navy #1A365D for current nav and My Weekend · 3. Materials: laser-print paper, aluminum clipboard, highlighter ink, hairline rules. Cool white paper.

TYPE: condensed grotesque for times and form headers (GUEST LIST, TIME, TITLE, VENUE, DOOR, KONSTANZ masthead). Readable grotesque for venue names and nav. NO serif. No Inter, no Bebas, no Playfair.

FORBIDDEN: stacked cards, hero banner, category chip row as the main event, glassmorphism, neon, neon-on-black, cream-editorial, terracotta, ticket checkout, Create, Profile, auth, photos of events, slideshow, card shadows, rounded product cards, marketplace tiles, Excel/spreadsheet chrome, zebra stripes, data-grid UI.

It must feel like a working guest list you mark up: paper on a clipboard, still a designed website UI. Full-fidelity first viewport, landscape 16:9 desktop.
